summary.text: Parker Fairbairn is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 107, which he has held since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a native of Petoskey, Michigan, who holds degrees from Northwood University.

paragraphs.text: Parker Fairbairn was born in Petoskey, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwood University in 2021 and a graduate degree from the same school in 2023.
He took office in the state House in 2025, succeeding Neil Friske.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Fairbairn described himself as an Emmet County native from a family that has lived in northern Michigan for five generations.

He said the district includes Emmet and Charlevoix counties and parts of Mackinac, Chippewa and Cheboygan counties, and that he was running to be a representative who "shows up" and puts Michigan and America first.
